data.description:
Kids can collect 1 of 12 LEGO® Shrek minifigure characters
75,
76,Delight any Shrek fan with 1 of 12 collectible characters from the LEGO® Minifigures Shrek Series (71053) mystery box for boys and girls aged 6 and over. Treat a kid or collector and let them enjoy the excitement of discovering which of the 12 random characters the minifigure pack contains. Will it be DreamWorks Animation’s Shrek, Fiona, Donkey, Pinocchio, Gingy, Dragon, Puss in Boots, Thelonious, Big Bad Wolf, Merlin, Lord Farquaad, Fairy Godmother or Prince Charming?
77,Each minifigure comes in a sealed mystery box and most include at least 1 themed accessory for added playtime fun. Kids can display each character alongside their existing collection of Shrek merch or recreate their favourite movie scenes. This small gift idea is a creative way to inspire pretend play for young builders who love LEGO toys.
